title: Four-digit counts and values
rationale: Overrides Kokoro's year-style reading when ordinary prose makes these numbers quantities.
originalText: The value is 1024. There are 2024 entries. The buffer contains 4096 bytes. The query returned 9999 results.
expectedPreparedText: The value is one thousand and twenty-four. There are two thousand and twenty-four entries. The buffer contains four thousand and ninety-six bytes. The query returned nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine results.

title: Thousands separator and decimal
rationale: Applies one cardinal policy whether the four-digit integer has a comma or a fractional part.
expectedPreparedText: The values are one thousand and twenty-four and one thousand and twenty-four point five.

title: Explicit historical years
rationale: Preserves year-style pronunciation when surrounding language explicitly identifies a year.
originalText: The year was 2024. In 1066, the situation changed. During 1999, the service expanded.
expectedPreparedText: The year was 2024. In 1066, the situation changed. During 1999, the service expanded.

title: Labelled numeric identifiers
rationale: Reads ports, version components, PINs, and build numbers as identifiers rather than years or cardinal quantities.
originalText: Use port 8080, version 2024.1, PIN 4096, and build 9999.
expectedPreparedText: Use port eight zero eight zero, version two zero two four point one, PIN four zero nine six, and build nine nine nine nine.

title: Already-correct number lengths
rationale: Preserves the number lengths Kokoro already reads naturally, including the special case 1000.
